decision_basis: Repository evidence and code inspection; not independent human adjudication or journal acceptance assessment.

qualified_conditions.condition: Finite inventory and exposure strata registered
qualified_conditions.limit: Registration is not primary runtime readiness; catalog overlap remains.

qualified_conditions.condition: Source-qualified control attribution and pair accounting
qualified_conditions.limit: 38 historical branches and 14 prospective RealWorld controls overlap; do not pool into independent samples. Primary negative-outcome contract remains P1/P2.
Eight RealWorld and six PetClinic control branches; equality covers recorded API-visible projections, not database atomicity or all future cases.

qualified_conditions.condition: Declared lifecycle probes and fresh controls
qualified_conditions.limit: Scoped checkpoints, not all phases. No blanket additional interruption campaign is a new prerequisite for unchanged paths.

qualified_conditions.condition: RealWorld tag/profile normalization and timing integration
qualified_conditions.limit: Does not silently extend to all profile fields, other applications or native-producer representations.

capacity_check.interpretation: Budget-envelope arithmetic, not measured duration or a claim that each case uses its timeout; excludes teardown and common setup.

open_blockers.title: Resolve terminal outcomes and repeat/stop semantics
open_blockers.finding: The planner schedules incomplete outcomes after a complete sweep, while the driver halts on every incomplete outcome and the Quartz wrapper raises before extraction on any unsuccessful runner exit. The reducer distinguishes only a finite set of completed statuses; application-response errors can therefore be censored with infrastructure failures.
completion: Register terminal classes for complete check mismatch, matched rejection, policy-unresolved observation, trace-supported application response failure, missing evidence, timeout and environment/cleanup failure.
Specify which terminal records continue the initial sweep, which trigger two diagnostic repeats, and which halt the campaign; reconcile the protocol and actual launcher.
Verify each class with source-shaped fixtures and a bounded engineering dispatch test; retain all attempt identities. Do not execute untouched boundary variants to tune this contract.
open_blockers.next_change: Implement a versioned outcome/stop contract before extending the candidate selection.

open_blockers.title: Bind the retained corpus to executable, qualified contracts
open_blockers.finding: Quartz campaign entry point selects only two route-control pairs. RealWorld prospective runner accepts only its complete one-pass engineering-control registry. PetClinic hosted wrapper uses a fixed integrity-control selection. These do not implement the declared eight-workflow primary campaign.
completion: Create an explicit candidate/pair-to-runner map for all retained primary entries, preserving development/generated/prospective exposure labels and singleton controls.
Bind each selected route to its reference control, exact input/binding checks, rejection-state observation, normalization contract and source-qualified component/outcome extractor.

Validate changed executable paths on declared engineering controls and fixture negative outcomes. Do not demand unregistered routes or a new-finding quota. Preserve exclusions only through a prospective, justified scope amendment.
open_blockers.next_change: Create the coverage map and implement the missing primary adapters using the existing qualified leaf components.

open_blockers.title: Make campaign batching and evidence aggregation bounded and immutable
open_blockers.finding: The application step has a nine-minute limit and current Quartz wrapper a 480-second outer limit. The initial Quartz plan alone has 44 branches with a 75-second per-case allowance; repeated candidates add eight branch slots each. No bounded primary batch/aggregation protocol exists.
completion: Predeclare batches, immutable campaign/job/attempt IDs, per-batch budgets and expected coverage before dispatch.
Aggregate declared initial batches only after checking source/environment identity and completeness; compute follow-ups deterministically from preserved terminal outcomes.

Distinguish planned batches within one campaign from forbidden replacement/merging of failed attempts. Missing or failed batches remain explicit; no resume by silently substituting successful observations.
Show that each batch fits its declared execution and teardown envelope; retain checkout/build/shared setup separately.
open_blockers.next_change: Implement bounded CI batches and a read-only completeness/aggregation validator.

open_blockers.title: Fulfil or prospectively amend the primary diagnostic timing contract
open_blockers.finding: RealWorld records exclusive adapter phases nested in branch time. The current primary cost protocol requires consistent phase boundaries across retained workflows; Quartz and PetClinic have not acquired that common contract. Selector calibration is separately deferred.
completion: Either implement the registered common exclusive phase boundaries across the retained primary workflows, or write a prospective scope amendment limiting primary cost reporting to supported end-to-end measures and deferring unsupported phase comparisons.

In either case retain all failed/interrupted work, disclose shared setup, and never sum nested timings or infer pure component costs from combined phases. No selector calibration is required for equal-candidate diagnostic observations.
open_blockers.next_change: Make the timing-scope decision before adding more timing instrumentation; record it before boundary outcomes.

open_blockers.title: Issue and enforce the dated primary freeze
open_blockers.finding: Preparation snapshots still explicitly set primary_freeze_complete=false. There is no executable final selection/source/environment acceptance manifest for the full intended campaign.
completion: Freeze selected corpus and exposure strata, commands, code/extractor hashes, requirements and unresolved-policy rubric, normalization, stop/repeat policy, batches, timing scope and runtime acceptance fields.

Preflight each batch against that manifest. Record hosted image/runtime metadata and define which differences require rejection or a new frozen execution context; do not rely on a moving ubuntu label alone or compare incidental run IDs as scientific environment fields.
Use existing lifecycle qualifications for unchanged owned-process paths. Requalify only materially changed lifecycle behavior and run the final ordinary-control smoke before primary dispatch.
Write an explicit dated freeze record and keep all previous snapshots and failed attempts.
open_blockers.next_change: Generate the final freeze only after P1-P4 have concrete completion evidence.

deferred_from_primary_execution.item: Timed selector efficacy and common-budget calibration
deferred_from_primary_execution.reason: Later Gate 4; equal-candidate diagnostic observations do not establish practical efficiency.
Required before confirmed-defect/novelty claims, not before collecting descriptive source-check observations. Unresolved cases stay explicit; AI review is not human agreement.
Need substantive results, literature positioning and manuscript review; control and harness counts do not establish Q1 readiness.
